writer: Root Codex; native quota failure respected, no alternate-account/model retry. Opus1 next-observation conclusion not read.
decision: First determine whether ordinary fixed floating point and exact observation-feature reuse make a new low-bit selector practically unnecessary. Do not proceed directly to a new selector or full MPC grid.
observations: Synthetic original/fresh CPU predictor outputs numerically equal and connected FP32 DINO-WM ran on one4090.
No real recorded observation/candidate ranking, ordinary FP16/BF16 benefit, simulator success, or concrete latency/memory requirement measured.
Publicly reported lower precision/control effects and generic decision-aware quantization already exist; current setup does not supply novelty.
smallest_next_check: Bounded real-input scoring/cost diagnostic, prepared before any new GPU launch. Pin one predetermined development episode/time/goal and fixed action candidates. Compare original FP32 rollout to an independently checked FP32 observation-feature-reuse path; then ordinary BF16 and FP16 predictor with the same FP32 encoder/features. No proposed quantizer yet.
why_not_quantizer_first: A useful need for low-bit execution has not been shown after the existing ordinary floating-point baseline. Fake quantization can perturb scores while giving no packed-memory or integer-GEMM benefit.
input_contract_before_run: Read the original dataset normalization, frameskip5, velocity/proprio4, image transform, goal and action grouping; exact source pins.
Use only previously retained val assets for the first development input; do not call it independent scientific holdout or train calibration.
No use of real terminal outcome in a deployable choice; FP32 objective is reference score, not task oracle.
Predeclare candidate actions and returned-mean interpretation. If not running actual CEM, name it a fixed-candidate diagnostic and do not claim MPC reproduction.
strong_baselines: FP32 observation-feature reuse with numerical output equivalence first
Same FP32 encoder plus ordinary fixed BF16/FP16 predictor; original FP32 action/proprio/fusion behavior explicitly controlled
report: Original versus reused output maxabs/allclose and call counts
Candidate score/selected-action disagreement and FP32 reference-score regret, numerical ties explicitly handled
Whole scoring-call wall/CUDA times with warmup, crossed order and repeated measurements; feature extraction/setup/amortization separately accounted
Actual dtypes, GPU/RSS peaks, weights bytes; no assumed quantization bandwidth gain
stop_scope: If reuse equivalence fails, stop the optimized path without changing numerical tolerance after seeing results.
If ordinary lower precision has favorable cost/reference-score behavior, use it as a baseline; this alone does not prove task quality or close all quantization research.
If no real resource constraint exists, report measured cost curves and stop claiming a resource violation or need for a complex selector.
Only after actual remaining decision error and practical cost gap are observed should low-bit-method design resume.
scope_limits: A proposed preparation and measurement direction only. Do not invoke new model/data loads or GPU from this document. Actual runtime grid/count/tolerance/noise/resource limits require a frozen follow-up spec and independent review.
